integrity: Original all-order statement is supported by self-contained combinatorial proof, symbolic generating-series derivation and a reproducible finite checker. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact result covers labelled bidirected simple cycles of order at least three; not directed, chorded, loopy or arbitrary symmetric argumentation frameworks. Numerical checks alone do not certify infinite results. Priority comparison may miss an equivalent formula in older three-state enumeration terminology.
title: Cyclic-gap classification and exact complete-extension polynomial of bidirected argumentation cycles
